entry_item.definition: v.t. To do something with one's own hands; to hand, give; to take in the hand, receive, accept; to accept responsibility, take charge of, manage.

example.definition: Person who has assumed the responsibility.
To take or receive with one's own hands, take personally.
To hand, give something to some-one personally.

entry_item.definition: rester en arrière, être en retard; 2 être surpassé, vaincu

entry_item.definition: v.i. To fall back. To be surpassed. To be overcome. Unable to overcome in argument.
